subject: MUC to LAX import quote
body:
Hi,

I’m arranging air freight from Germany for our buyer’s import at LAX. We’ll deliver to MUC ourselves; the goods will be ready on 2026-11-29.

The import shipment is 12 pieces of electronic control units, 350 kg gross and 3.33 cbm. Could you quote the fastest option with an all-in price in EUR?

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in quote for a new air-freight shipment from MUC to LAX.
